title: Player receives no damage from threat enemy contact (enemy frozen)
explanation: At frame 726 an enemy_reversed_at_wall event reports old_direction=0.0 and new_direction=0.0, and the next snapshot (frame 780) shows Enemy5 vel_x=0.0, indicating the enemy is frozen. At frame 1767 a state_snapshot shows Enemy5 (is_threat=true) at distance 80.0 from the player, satisfying the contact definition, yet stats.deaths remains 0. A later snapshot at frame 1909 still shows the same contact and deaths unchanged, and no player_died/player_hurt events occur in the window, confirming missing damage.
